Background delivery

Enabled weather checks send your saved coordinates to weather and warning providers with the app closed; they do not read a new device location. Android may delay them during sleep or battery restrictions. Allow background activity in the app battery settings. After Force stop, reopen the app. Delivery is not guaranteed at an exact time.
Huawei and Honor: in Power usage details, open Launch settings. Choose manual management and allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. This may use more battery.
